decision_criteria: If the current release documentation already contains the required disclosure of the material segment weakness, the verdict could move toward compliant_with_caveats or compliant depending on the completeness of the packet.

If neither current disclosure nor approved mitigation exists, certification is noncompliant under the stated policy.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but not sufficient when the policy predicate on current disclosure or approved mitigation is unresolved.

specific_concerns: The governing policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and disclose material segment weaknesses or include an approved mitigation.
